2: For the music director. Of David. To bring to remembrance. O God, make haste to deliver me. O Yahweh, make haste to help me.
3: Let them be ashamed and abashed who seek my life. Let them be repulsed and humiliated who desire my harm.
4: let them turn back because of their shame, those who say, “Aha! Aha!”
5: Let them rejoice and be glad in you, all those who seek you. Let them say continually, “God is great!” those who love your salvation.
6: But I am poor and needy; O God hasten to me. You are my help and my deliverer. O Yahweh, do not delay.
